title: Function tenant context, batch 5: platform-invoked workers (email-submission-processor, ses-inbound-receive, slack-delivery, slack-events, console-chat-responder) and the schedulers that invoke content-actions tasks
description: Move these handlers to the TenantContext, and make every invoker of a content-actions projectionTask (reproject-on-deploy, reader-steering snapshot schedule, home-page stream trigger and schedule) name the tenant in the task on a shared stack.
